title: 1. Her supplication for her husband
categoryChain: Her supplications for herself and others for the world and the hereafter
introduction:
Her supplication for her husband

She said in her bequest: When I pass away, give funeral bath to me with your hands and anoint and shroud me; and bury me at night, and so and so should not attend my funeral; and I don’t want to make any further bequest. To Allah I leave you till we meet in the hereafter.

verses.arabic: جَمَعَ اللهُ بَيْنِىْ وَ بَيْنَكَ فِىْ دَارِهٖ وَ قُرْبِ جِوَارِهٖ۔
